useCases: Work on everything at once: every task gets its own worktree, branch and agent, and they all run side by side.
See every agent work: steps, sub-agents and screenshots arrive live, and you can steer mid-run.
Answers you can see: live tables, charts, diagrams and task cards right in the conversation.
readmeSummary: Describe a task and Beluga makes a fresh worktree for it: its own folder, branch and agent, named for the task.
